entries.title: Ask HN: What could a modern database do that PostgreSQL and MySQL can't
entries.author: eatonphil
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What could a modern database do that PostgreSQL and MySQL can't
entries.excerpt: If there were a general-purpose OLTP SQL database that was developed today, what features or design decisions would it pick that PostgreSQL and MySQL cannot adapt for historic reasons? Or put another way, what are some cutting edge OLTP database techniques/features/architectures that PostgreSQL and MySQL would have a hard time supporting?
entries.guide_zh: 如果今天重新设计通用事务数据库，应该加入 PostgreSQL、MySQL 缺少的什么？

entries.title: Ask HN: Where are all the old Show HNs?
entries.author: behnamoh
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Where are all the old Show HNs?
entries.excerpt: Searching for "Show HN" posts (using hn.algolia.com) reveals a sad story: Many of them are gone. I wonder what happens to Shown HNs, esp. the ones that are featured on HN, but then end up not existing anymore. Is it the server costs? Do they sell to other companies? Did the developer pass away and so did the link?
entries.guide_zh: 旧 Show HN 项目大量消失了，发帖者追问这些作品后来的命运。

entries.title: Ask HN: Books that teach you programming languages via systems projects?
entries.author: Foe
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Books that teach you programming languages via systems projects?
entries.excerpt: Looking for a book/textbook that teaches you a programming language through systems (or vice versa). For example, a book that teaches modern C++ by showing you how to program a compiler; a book that teaches operating systems and the language of choice in the book is Rust; a book that teaches database internals through Golang; etc. Basically, looking for a fun project-based book that I can walk through and spend my free time working through. Any recommendations?
entries.guide_zh: 有哪些教材通过构建系统项目来教编程语言，让语言学习与工程实践结合？
